components: Header: Cosmic gradient background (#070B1F) with circular logo 'K' + wordmark 'R-Conekta by RRClub', user greeting, PWA install badge.
Quick Action Banner: Instant access to Member QR Pass with one-touch modal trigger.
Featured Campaigns Carousel: High-impact hero card showcasing top discount offer with percentage badge, partner thumbnail, and remaining time counter.
Nearby Partners Section: Filterable pill tags (Restaurantes, Beleza, Moda, Experiências) followed by partner cards with distance badges (e.g., '350m Lisboa').
Instant Discounts & Coupon Grid: Quick coupon cards with single-tap 'Resgatar Cupão' CTA leading to /c/:code.
Bottom Navigation: 4 tabs (Início, Campanhas, Meu QR, Perfil) optimized for thumb navigation.
Header: Compact cosmic header with back button and verification badge.
Coupon Detail Card: Partner logo, offer title, discount value tag (e.g. '-20% em Refeições'), rules and expiry countdown.
Dynamic P5 QR Pass: Sharp monochrome SVG/Canvas QR Code with copyable reference code in font-coupon.
Payment Selector: Switcher tabs for MB WAY (Portugal), Pix (Brasil), Apple Pay (Stripe), and Credit Card.
Payment Form / Quick Checkout: Phone number input for MB WAY, Copy-Paste key for Pix, or instant Stripe card element.
Digital Receipt Card: Post-payment breakdown with instant confirmation checkmark and share button.
Header: Dark cosmic header with partner business name, today's total validations counter, and quick status indicator.
Hero QR Scanner Scanner Module: Full-width interactive QR scanner camera viewport with animated scanner line and manual code fallback.
Amount Confirmation Card: Large numeric keypad or touch input for validation amount, auto-calculating commission and discount.
Recent Transactions Feed: Live feed of validated customer coupons with status badges (Confirmado, Pendente) and tabular amounts.
Top Influencers Leaderboard: Quick list of top driving influencers with conversion counts.
Bottom Navigation: 3 tabs (Scanner, Histórico, Definicações).
Header: Premium cosmic header displaying confirmed wallet balance in EUR/BRL and quick cashout CTA.
KPI Cards Row: 3 metric widgets (Visualizações, Conversões, Comissões Confirmadas) with growth arrows.
Active Campaigns Grid: Campaign cards with customized referral links and quick 'Partilhar WhatsApp' / 'Partilhar Instagram' triggers.
Personal QR Code Share Card: Customizable QR card ready for instant downloading or story sharing.
Earnings Statement Preview: Link to detailed statement (/influencer/extrato) with breakdown per partner.
Bottom Navigation: 4 tabs (Painel, Links, Extrato, Perfil).
Header: Dark executive cosmic header with system status indicator and notification bell.
Financial Executive KPIs: GMV total, platform fee revenue, active partner count, pending payouts total.
Partner & Campaign Management Quick Table: Compact responsive cards for instant approval or status toggles.
Payout Approval Queue: Fast action list to confirm influencer commission payouts.
Bottom Navigation: 4 tabs (Dashboard, Gestão, Pagamentos, Definições).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='partner-qr-scan-btn').
Prioritize single-handed mobile usability: touch targets minimum 44x44px, key action buttons placed in lower screen reach zone.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled select inputs.
Maintain high APCA text contrast over the dark cosmic header backgrounds.
